title: Readiness 1 · Select through sorting
prompt: For every customer who lives in the USA or Canada and signed up during 2024, return first_name, city and contact. contact is the customer's email, or the text none when the email is missing. Put the newest signup first.
hints: Three things are needed: a filter with two parts, a fallback for a missing value, and an order.
Keep the two countries together so the date test applies to both. BETWEEN includes both ends.
WHERE country IN ('USA', 'Canada') AND signup_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY signup_date DESC

wrongAnswers.misconception: Mixes OR and AND without brackets, so the date test applies to one country only.
Returns the email as it is, so a missing one shows NULL.

feedback: Check a customer from the USA who signed up in 2023, and a customer whose email is missing.
